review_question: Can a rota agent find, read and act on waiting billing tickets on the current queue page, and what blocks keyboard and zoom users?

findings.title: Search field and refresh button have no accessible name
findings.notice: The search input relies on a placeholder, and the refresh button holds only an image with no alt text.
findings.because: Without a programmatic name, the two controls an agent uses most have no label once text is typed or when announced.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible label 'Search tickets' tied to the input by for and id, give the button the text 'Refresh queue', and mark the icon alt="".

findings.title: Focus outline removed from toolbar controls
findings.notice: The toolbar links and button set outline to none, and no focus-visible rule replaces it.
findings.because: A keyboard user cannot see which control is focused.
findings.recommendation: Delete the outline reset and add a :focus-visible rule with a 3px ring in a colour that meets 3:1 against the toolbar.

findings.title: Waiting time and late badge text are below 4.5:1
findings.notice: The waiting-time text uses the hint grey on white, and the late badge sets white on a light red.
findings.because: Waiting time is the fact an agent compares at night; at this contrast it is hard to read.
findings.recommendation: Set the waiting time in the body ink colour and darken the badge red until white text reaches 4.5:1.

findings.title: Pinch zoom is disabled
findings.notice: The viewport meta sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no.
findings.because: Agents on phones cannot enlarge ticket text.

findings.title: No language, landmarks, skip link or ordered headings
findings.notice: The page has no lang attribute, no main landmark, no skip link, jumps from h1 to h3 and sets a positive tabindex on the search field.
findings.because: Assistive technology cannot pronounce or navigate the page by region or heading, and the tab order no longer follows the layout.
findings.recommendation: Add lang="en", wrap the queue in <main id="main"> with a skip link before the toolbar, change the h3 to h2 and remove tabindex="3".

findings.title: Error and call-to-action copy say nothing useful
findings.notice: The error reads 'Oops! Something went wrong.' and the main button says 'Supercharge your queue'.
findings.because: The error gives no cause or next step, and the button does not name what the click does.
findings.recommendation: Say what failed and what to do ('Tickets did not load. Reload the queue.') and name the action ('Take next ticket').

findings.title: Template styling: purple-blue gradient button and uniform 24px radius
findings.notice: The main button is a purple-to-blue gradient and every card uses the same large radius.
findings.because: Both read as a generic template on a working tool and compete with the ticket data.
findings.recommendation: Use one solid accent the palette owns for the primary action and a small radius hierarchy.

findings.title: Toolbar links go nowhere
findings.because: The navigation looks usable but does not move the agent anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Link to the real queue and macro routes, and mark the current page with aria-current="page".

findings.title: Card transition ignores reduced motion
findings.notice: Cards animate transform over 300ms with ease-in and there is no reduced-motion rule.
findings.because: People who ask for less motion still get it, and ease-in feels sluggish on entry.
findings.recommendation: Add a prefers-reduced-motion rule that removes the transition and use an ease-out curve.
